title: Profiler scopes
description:
Collect nested timing scopes into a tree with totals, as an in-game profiler does.

```
Frame            16.4 ms
  Update          6.1 ms
    Physics       4.0 ms
    AI            2.0 ms
  Render          9.8 ms
    Shadows       3.2 ms
```
hints: `begin` finds or creates the child of `m_current` with that name and makes it current; `end` adds `now - started` and goes back to the parent (lesson 6.02).
A `Scope` stores the profiler and calls `end` in its destructor, so early `return`s still close the scope.
requirements: `begin(name, time)` and `end(time)` calls build a tree; a scope with the same name under the same parent adds up.
A RAII `Scope` object calls `begin` and `end` automatically.
Print the tree with indentation and each scope's total time.
stretch: Keep the last 60 frames and show the average of each scope.
